blocks.title: Inheritance
blocks.text: Inheritance ek class ko doosri class ke attributes aur methods lene deti hai. Yeh code ke dobara istemal ko barhati aur classes ki darja-bandi banati hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: Dog aur Cat Animal se inherit karti hain, aur har subclass make_sound() ko override kar ke apni awaz nikalti hai.

blocks.explanation: "Animal sound": base class apna version rakhti hai.

items: Inheritance: class Dog(Animal) Animal ko dobara istemal karti hai; subclasses methods override kar sakti hain.
